entries.en: Fai Dan will explain what is needed. Speak with him if you have questions.
Fai Dan is our leader. He has the clearest understanding of our situation.
I'm grateful for what you've done, but your heroics don't impress me, Commander.
You can't speak for yourself?
Goodbye.
I fought so hard, but any thought of my own caused so much pain.
We can rebuild this place. We're stronger than the company gives us credit for.
I hope we can make this colony work.
So much wasted effort. I guess it's back to security work around Jump Zero for me.
I'm getting out with my life. I guess that's something.
I want to talk to you.
Bye.
How would you feel if you were hung out to dry by every government organization that ever promised to keep you safe?
And you're only interested in the geth.
I'm a rent-a-cop. I was hired to keep kids from writing graffiti on the walls at ExoGeni. Then all this happened.
I wasn't trained for this. I didn't ask for it. I just want it to end.
I can't tell you anything about that. I suggest you go to ExoGeni if you want answers to those questions.
Very little. I worked there as a security officer. I know they were looking for artifacts and anything of value.
That's what they do. They fund the colony. In return, we help them uncover buried treasure.
It's definitely not as exciting as they make it sound.
I can't tell you much about it. You should speak to Fai Dan if you want to know more.
I get the feeling you don't like me.
Tell me more about yourself, Arcelia.
What can you tell me about the geth? Do you have any idea what they might be after?
What can you tell me about ExoGeni?
Tell me about Zhu's Hope.
Reason for anger
Personal questions
Geth
ExoGeni
Colony
Commander.
They should've sent a small fleet. Instead, we get one ship.
Fine.
Invaders! Your every step is a transgression. A thousand feelers appraise you as meat, good only to dig or decompose.
I speak for the Old Growth, as I did for Saren. You are within and before the Thorian. It commands that you be in awe!
Saren sought knowledge of those who are gone. The Old Growth listened to flesh for the first time in the Long Cycle. Trades were made.
Then cold ones began killing the flesh that would tend the next cycle. Flesh fairly given! The Old Growth sees the air you push as lies! It will listen no more!
No more will the Thorian listen to those that scurry. Your lives are short, but have gone on too long.
Your blood will feed the ground and the new growth!
The Thorian is a piece of this world, extending across the land and back through the ages. You can no more kill it than cut the sky.
I'm free. I'm free.
I will do what I can to assist the colony in this difficult time. I am ashamed of the damage  done to the lives of these people.
You gave something to Saren. Something I need.
Give me what I need and I'll strike back at the one who betrayed you.
I won't let you keep your thralls. Release them. Now!
I don't argue with plants. Give me what I want. Now!
You enslaved the colonists! You destroyed their minds. I don't know what Saren wanted with you, but I just want you dead!
I-- I suppose I should thank you for releasing me.
I will remain here until the last of your kind is gone. I am greatly ashamed for what happened here.
To understand, you must have access to endemic ancestral memory. A viewpoint spanning thousands of Prothean generations.
I sensed this ancestral memory--the Cipher--when I melded with the Thorian. Our identities merged, our minds intertwined. Such knowledge cannot be taught; it simply exists.
There is a way. I can transfer the knowledge from my mind to yours, as I did with Saren.
I have given you the Cipher, just as it was given to Saren. The ancestral memories of the Protheans are a part of you now.
Are you all right, Shepard? What did she do?
You have been given a great gift: the experience of an entire people. It will take time for your mind to process this information.
Are you all right? What just happened?
What was that? Shepard, are you all right?
What just happened? Are you okay?
A knowledge bond can be very traumatic. Are you all right, Commander Shepard?
The Cipher is the very essence of being a Prothean. It cannot be described or explained. It would be like describing color to a creature without eyes.
I saw... something. It still didn't make any sense.
All I saw were more weird visions. It still didn't make sense!
Farewell, Commander. I wish you well in your hunt.
Farewell, Shiala.
I'm okay.
She messed up my mind!
Goodbye.
I need what Saren came for.
I'll destroy you!
I'm after Saren.
Let the colonists go.
Enough negotiating.
This flesh is reborn! You will be destroyed!
The Old Growth is older than you can fathom!
The Long Cycle must continue!
You are nothing! Nutrients to feed upon!
I am fine. Or I will be, in time.
This is no trick. The Thorian is dead and I am myself again.
My name is Shiala. I serve-- I served Matriarch Benezia. When she allied herself with Saren, so did I.
I came to this world in search of the Thorian. Saren needed its knowledge. And he needed my biotic abilities to communicate with it.
Is everything all right? Are you hurt?
How do I know this isn't some kind of trick?
How did you end up inside that... thing?
Are you okay?
I don't trust you.
Who are you?
Saren offered me in trade. I was sacrificed to secure an alliance between Saren and the Thorian.
Saren is quick to betray his followers and his allies. Once he had what he needed, he ordered his geth to destroy the Thorian.
He was quick to betray the Thorian, too. After he had what he wanted, he ordered the geth to destroy all evidence of its existence.
Saren knows you are searching for the Conduit. He knows you are following his steps. He attacked the Thorian so you could not gain the Cipher.
That's what you get for trusting Saren.
Saren's pretty quick to betray his own people.
Then why were the geth trying to destroy the Thorian?
What's the Cipher? And why did Saren need it?
Serves you right.
That's horrible!
They were allies?
Tell me what it is.
The beacon on Eden Prime gave you visions. But the visions are unclear, confusing. They were meant for a Prothean mind.
To truly comprehend them, you must think like a Prothean. You must understand their culture, their history, their very existence.
The Thorian was here long before the Protheans built this city. It watched and studied them. When they died, it consumed them. They became a part of it.
Sounds like you asari got in over your heads for once.
She tried to manipulate Saren. But in the end, her plan backfired.
She tried to manipulate Saren. But in the end, her plan backfired.
Typical asari meddling. About time it bit you in the ass.
Benezia sought to turn the river and was swept away.
Benezia underestimated Saren. As I did. We came to believe in his cause and his goals. The strength of his influence is troubling.
Saren has a vessel. An enormous warship unlike anything I've ever seen. He calls it Sovereign. It can dominate the minds of his followers.
They become indoctrinated to Saren's will. The process is subtle. It can take days, weeks. But in the end, it is absolute.
Your suspicions are understandable. But you freed me from the Thorian, and from Saren. I am on your side now.
If you allow it, I would like to stay here with the colonists. They have suffered greatly, and I played a role in their suffering. I would like to make amends.
So be it. If this is the fate you feel I deserve, then I will not resist.
Thank you, Commander. May fortune smile upon you.
Then I wish good fortune upon you. Saren must be stopped before he finds the Conduit. As for me, I will stay here with the colonists.
I feel great shame for my part in their suffering. As long as any of the colonists remain on this world, I will do whatever I can to aid and protect them.
Just give me some plain answers! Where is the Cipher?
So the Thorian taught Saren to think like a Prothean? How?
Where is the Cipher? How do I get it?
You chose to side with Saren. So did Matriarch Benezia.
Are you saying Saren can control minds?
Asari Matriarchs are among the most intelligent and powerful beings in the galaxy. How could one fall under Saren's control?
Now that you're free of the Thorian, what are you planning to do next?
You were allied with Saren. For all I know, you still are. I can't just let you walk away.
You change sides too often. I have no choice. You must die.
The colonists will need all the help they can get. They'll be happy to have you on their side.
I can't spend any more time here. Not while Saren's still out looking for the Conduit.
What else can you tell me about Saren?
Tell me more about this ship Saren has.
I want to know more about Benezia.
Is there anything else you can tell me about the Thorian?
I want to know more about you.
Enough mystic crap!
So the Cipher is knowledge?
I don't understand.
Quit making excuses.
What do you mean?
There's more to this.
What should I do with you?
I can't let you go.
I should leave.
I can't let you live.
A noble idea.
Sounds good to me.
Saren
Sovereign
The Matriarch
The Thorian
Personal questions
You look a little queasy. We should get you back to the ship.
We should get you back to the ship where you can be monitored.
You look pretty rough. We should get you back to the ship.
We should get you back to the ship, Commander. Medical needs to know about this.
You look a little unsteady, Shepard. Perhaps you should return to the Normandy.
I am sorry if you have suffered, but there was no other way. You needed the Cipher. In time, it will help you understand the vision from the beacon.
There is little I could tell you that you do not already know. He is powerful. He is charismatic. And he is dangerous.
Once I followed him, blind to his true nature. But now I see he is leading the galaxy into an age of darkness and suffering.
Sovereign is alien. I do not know how it was built, or where it comes from. Its design does not match that of any known spacefaring species.
It dwarfs any vessel in the Citadel or Alliance fleets. Its weapons are devastating; its defenses, virtually impenetrable. With it, Saren believes he is unstoppable.
The indoctrination. There is an energy about Sovereign. You feel drawn to the ship. It makes Saren's arguments more persuasive, more compelling.
Spend enough time in Sovereign's presence and you will lose yourself. There is no other way to explain it.
Benezia was greatly respected among our people. A powerful biotic, even for an asari. She was widely known as a teacher of philosophy and religion.
She always sought the paths of peace and harmony. She joined with Saren because she hoped to turn him away from his path of destruction.
As I mentioned before, Matriarch Benezia underestimated Saren. Be sure you do not make the same mistake.
No. I'm sorry. All I know is that Saren believes the Conduit was the key to the Prothean extinction.
That can't be good, whatever it is.
Well then whatever it is, we can't let him have it.
That can't be good, whatever it is.
Then whatever it is, we cannot let him have it.
Then whatever it is, we can't let him have it.
You have the Cipher. In time, your visions will clear. They will lead you to the Conduit. I only pray you find it before Saren does.
When the creature enveloped me, I became part of it. But I still don't truly understand it. So alien. So ancient.
Its exact age is impossible to know. It measured time differently. Ten thousand years of hibernation broken by a few frantic centuries of activity.
Its mind was awesome. Magnificent. It transcended all classification. And now it is gone.
The Thorian was a unique life-form -- a sentient being that lived for 50,000 years, maybe more. There is nothing even remotely like it in the known galaxy.
I am grateful you saved me from a life of thralldom. Yet I cannot help but feel some sorrow for the loss of such a rare and remarkable creature.
There is nothing remarkable about me. I was merely one of Matriarch Benezia's disciples. For nearly two centuries, I followed her, learning at her feet.
When Benezia revealed her plan to join Saren, she gave her disciples a choice. Only those who were willing had to follow her. Many felt her plan was too dangerous.
But I believed in her. I thought she could turn Saren away from his insanity. Instead, we joined him in it.
You said Saren uses it to manipulate his followers.
Instead, she became one of his most powerful allies.
Do you know what the Conduit is? Or where it is?
The galaxy's a better place with that thing dead and gone.
Don't tell me you feel sorry for that thing.
Don't worry. I'll be fine.
The Conduit
It controls minds?
It backfired.
It was an abomination!
You sound almost sad.
Don't worry. I'll be fine.
Don't worry. I'll be fine.
Don't worry. I'll be fine.
Don't worry. I'll be fine.
Benezia foresaw the influence Saren would have. She joined him to guide him down a gentler path. But Saren is compelling. Benezia lost her way.
After Saren had what he needed, the Thorian became a liability.
I was a willing slave when Saren brought me to this world. He needed my biotics to communicate with the Thorian, to learn its secrets.
I'm here to make a deal.
He tricked her?
How is this possible?
How is this possible?
How is this possible?
How is this possible?
How is this possible?
What does it do?
Try to relax, Commander. Slow, deep breaths. Let go of your physical shell. Reach out to grasp the threads that bind us, one to another.
Every action sends ripples across the galaxy. Every idea must touch another mind to live. Each emotion must mark another's spirit.
Embrace eternity!
I need that knowledge to stop Saren!
You taught Saren. You can teach me.
I need the Cipher.
There has to be some way!
You gave it to Saren.
I need that information.
We are all connected. Every living being united in a single, glorious existence. Open yourself to the universe, Commander.
It just can't get worse than this.
Feros could have been great if we'd had the support we asked for.
We don't even know where the geth came from.
We fought hard for this colony.
We'll start over. What else can we do?
ExoGeni has obligations here. Hopefully they learned their lesson.
We've never had funding like this before.
You really forced ExoGeni to see our potential.
I'm taking the money and running.
I'll keep my mouth shut, that's for sure.
They wiped out our defenses in minutes.
This wouldn't have happened if ExoGeni had backed us from the start.
Those geth never gave us a chance.
We fought hard for this colony, but we're not soldiers.
I hope ExoGeni knows enough to stay out of our way now.
It's nice to finally get the support we deserve.
I never thought we'd get this much support from the home office.
Could be worse things than a bribe.
I'll keep my mouth shut. I really don't like the alternative.
How are we supposed to fight an enemy like this?
If only ExoGeni had supported us from the start.
I hope you fare better against the geth.
The frontier is a lot more dangerous than we were told.
I hope ExoGeni learned their lesson.
Colonial Affairs is going to hear about this.
It looks like the colony will survive after all.
This is great. We'll have more than enough to make it work this time.
This is a huge loss. We could have made something of this place.
I'm taking whatever I can get and never looking back.
We've been trapped for days.
ExoGeni could have prevented all this in the first place.
It was over in hours. The geth crushed us completely.
There's not much you can do when a force like that shows up on your doorstep.
I hope everyone just leaves us in peace now.
ExoGeni better come through or this will be all over Colonial Affairs.
All of a sudden, it's like we're worth something.
I'll take the money. I don't like it, but I'll take it.
It beats dying, I guess.
I hope you can get us out of this mess.
If ExoGeni had just put in a bit more support from the start....
This place is a lot worse than I expected.
Feros can work. It just needs help.
ExoGeni better fund us like they agreed to in the first place.
It's about time someone gave that ExoGeni stooge what he deserved.
You sure get results.
I don't know how you convinced them to reinvest, but thank you.
I'm getting out while I can.
Time to get the hell out of here.
If I survive this, I'm going back to Earth.
We asked for help in the beginning, but they didn't listen.
I don't know if the colony can survive this.
We tried to fight on our own, but the geth were too much.
We'll make it. It'll be rough, but we'll make it.
We can do this. We just need the chance.
I've never seen such a turnaround by a company.
It's time to leave this all behind.
I've never seen a colony fold so fast.
We ran when the attack hit.
I don't think any of the colonies get the support they deserve.
The geth just blindsided us. We never stood a chance.
Every colony deserves a chance.
Hopefully, everyone leaves us alone for awhile.
Maybe the home office will get off their asses and help us now.
Huh. I hope the new money doesn't spoil this place.
It will be interesting to see what Feros looks like in a year.
I guess taking the easy way out is our only choice.
I'll take the deal, but it leaves a bad taste in my mouth.
Why build a colony if you don't intend to defend it?
You'd think ExoGeni would be more interested in protecting their investment.
I'll be glad when this is all over.
We're not soldiers. We didn't stand a chance against the geth.
I hope ExoGeni learned from this.
Colonial Affairs needs to rein in companies like ExoGeni.
You won't recognize this place when we're done.
I'm leaving as soon as possible.
I don't need to be told twice. I'm taking my credits and running.
Any luck finding my workstation out in the ruins?
That's very good news, indeed. Thank you.
Plans for a few prototype mods.
I'm a freelancer. Some of my mods are highly sought after.
Maybe I've got a bit of the frontier spirit in me. That, and the alternative is a bit too "secure" for my liking.
Freelancers don't have to worry about security as much, so long as we keep a low profile.
Ah, that's for smarter men than me to figure out. I have no idea what anyone would want with this ruin.
Just keep in mind what I said.
Thanks again. That data will be very valuable, once I get out of here.
Hmm... they could survive out there, no problem.
Yeah, they could find it, no problem.
I wonder if I should ask for their help.
What's the harm in asking? As long as it doesn't get in their way.
I was hoping you'd have a moment to speak with me. I've got a bit of a problem.
I understand. Just hear me out.
I need to retrieve some data. It's not a big job, but it pays well.
Good. I don't want to get myself killed before I can leave this place.
Good, good. Poking around in the ruins has become a bit too dangerous for me.
All right. Just remember there's money to be made if you want it.
What is it about you that makes people assume we enjoy being in harm's way?
It's not that bad, really.
All you need to do is find my console at ExoGeni headquarters and drop the data onto this OSD. It's that simple.
I appreciate it. That data could be worth a lot of money.
Of course, this all depends on getting out of here alive.
After this disaster I could use a little good news. A few credits to get me started again.
Just come and see me when you've got the data.
Have you seen anyone else heading to ExoGeni lately?
Well, that's very comforting. Certain death for some, fine for us.
Deadly for him, fine for us. What could be better?
People are quick to assume we enjoy being in hazardous situations.
Why do people always assume we enjoy putting ourselves in harm's way?
Fair enough.
I managed to find the data and transfer it to your OSD.
Tell me about the data I'm getting for you.
Why work in the middle of nowhere if your skills are so useful?
Do you have any idea what the geth were looking for?
Time to get moving.
I don't really have time to spare right now.
I'm listening.
This really isn't the time.
I'll look around if I get the chance.
You're awfully quick to trust me with this.
I'm not interested in this.
I'm done with this planet.
Everybody wants something. Hurry up about it.
Data
Reason for being here
Not now.
Just get to the point.
Go on.
No, thanks.
I'm not sticking around.
I might be able to help.
Why me?
Forget it.
I found your data.
Reason for the attack
Goodbye.
Just keep it in mind while you are out there. Good luck, Commander.
I haven't found your workstation or data yet.
I didn't find anything.
No catch, really. It's dangerous work, but not for someone like you.
Well, I appreciate it. Here. You've certainly earned this.
You bet. Thanks for all your help, Commander.
Sounds easy enough. What's the catch?
It wasn't too difficult.
Just give me my credits and I'll be on my way.
I was there anyway. It was the least I could do.
What do you need?
Sure.
Payment.
No problem.
Of course.
Okay.
All right. I'll help.
Thanks again, Commander.
Forget it.
Please keep your fire to a minimum when you go to the ExoGeni building. We want to minimize damage.
Oh, and I must inform you that the company will not be responsible for any injuries you sustain while in our facility.
None. We're scrambling to find anything of value.
Please. ExoGeni Corp. is the premier engine of colonization in the new multi-system economy.
And in conjunction with our core interests, exploration provides a broad investment base for shareholders.
ExoGeni has a number of subsidiary companies in many different fields. The most profitable adapt alien technologies.
There are many other industrial branches, but they aren't really relevant to Feros.
Me? I was sent here to do some routine estimations of the potential return on investment.
I can't wait for the home office to get me off this rock.
Please be careful if you go to headquarters. We don't want any unnecessary damage to the facility.
Still here? No rush, I suppose. ExoGeni will sort things out, given time.
I know what you did on Torfan. There's no reason for this to get bloody.
Commander. Glad to see you survived your encounter with the Thorian.
Do you have any idea why the geth attacked you?
Tell me about ExoGeni.
What are the company's "core interests"?
Tell me about yourself, Jeong.
I'm going.
Not this time, Jeong. You need to back down and let them go.
What do you think you're doing, Jeong?
If that's the way it has to be, then come on!
Opportunities? What the hell are you talking about?
Well, yeah. No one's ever gone broke playing the "champion of humanity" card.
Nice! I guess it could be left intentionally undeveloped to capitalize on its "rough" appeal. Right?
Sadly, you'd probably make a killing. But if it will let us get back to our lives, I'm for it.
It just might work. Wait, no, but the infected colonists will throw a bit of a wrench in that plan. No, no. They need to disappear.
ExoGeni will send more assayers. They'll know what happened.
But if word gets out about the Thorian.... How do I know they'll stay quiet?
I won't shut up! I'll talk about it to anyone who will listen!
But-- But it's not fair. Not after everything.
I guess that's all that matters now.
Take the money and run. It seems like that's all anyone cares about.
Communications are back up. ExoGeni wants this place purged.
You don't understand. It's not that easy.
This is a human colony, Jeong. You can't just re-purpose us.
I won't let you hurt these people any more. Drop your weapon or be prepared to use it!
Can't you see the inherent potential in this colony? Think of the promotional opportunities!
They recovered from an alien attack on a frontier world. Add that to your company profile.
Pitch it as "Humanity against all odds!" You could even sell tickets to wealthy adventurers.
Pay them. Give them passage off this world and be done with it.
They lose even more if they talk. Besides, there's no real crime to report if you let them go.
This isn't so bad. At least you have your life. You can start over anywhere.
Let's get this over with.
If they talk, they lose everything for no reason at all. They'll stay quiet.
Are you going to tell them about the Thorian, or should I?
You're after the one unique thing Feros has: the Thorian.
If you kill only the Thorian, it might be enough to stop the infection. Maybe.
Just make sure there's no evidence when you're done.
Maybe there is. Come and talk to me before you leave, Commander.
There has to be another way.
All traces of the Thorian will be erased in short order. Feros will have a second chance thanks to you.
It's worth a try, but I don't know if I can avoid harming the colonists.
Good plan. Except that the colonists stand between me and the Thorian.
Anything hostile will be eliminated.
You shouldn't be wasting time. Deal with the Thorian.
Let them go!
Explain yourself!
Species 37.
The Thorian.
I'm ending this now!
What about the big picture?
Just pay them off.
Feros will be a symbol.
Movie rights and tourism!
Sounds logical.
They'll try to stop me.
Can't take that chance.
Think about it.
They won't talk.
It could be worse.
I'm done here.
Geth attack
ExoGeni Corporation
Personal questions
Goodbye.
Core interests?
Hah, Shepard. Damn it! I knew it was too much to hope the geth would kill you.
Hold it right there, Commander. This is an ExoGeni project. I'm taking control.
It's a telepathic life-form living under Zhu's Hope.
The what?
A Spectre? That's a load of crap. There aren't any human Spectres. Right?
You're a bean-counter, Jeong. I'm a Spectre. Tell me, how good are those odds?
I'll kill you first.
I know what you did during the Blitz, but your heroics aren't needed here.
I know what happened on Akuze. This doesn't have to end like that.
We can talk this out. Nobody needs to get hurt.
Stay calm.
I think this plan of yours just might work.
I'm preparing the proposal for ExoGeni. I think they'll like it.
I don't know. It's a crazy idea. But, hey, if there's money involved, maybe ExoGeni will at least consider it.
Still here, Shepard. Don't worry. I won't renege on our deal.
Now that there's no evidence, we can all just leave.
The colonists will soon be moving on to their new lives.
It's a pricey solution, but better than the alternative.
I like people. I just like them more when they're helping ExoGeni profit.
Someone needs to worry about the bottom line. I'm the only one left.
There's nothing here to warrant an invasion. There's barely enough here to warrant a colony.
The attack was certainly a surprise to me. I've been trapped here ever since.
I found some interesting facts about you in the ExoGeni database.
It's not just you. There's something here far more valuable than a few colonists.
It's taking control of the colonists there. ExoGeni knew all along.
You won't get away with this, Jeong.
So you keep saying. But nobody's going to miss a few colonists.
Is that really a chance you're willing to take, Jeong?
Yeah, but the infected colonists can't be here when the company men come.
You can't just kill the colonists. It's not their fault.
Then you'd be the first one to go to prison. Your signature's on half the Thorian reports.
For this to work, there can't be any evidence. The infected colonists need to disappear.
You're not much of a people person, are you?
What the hell are you talking about?
What are you doing to these people?
Tell them the geth destroyed the Thorian.
Make the offer sweet enough and they'll take it. And they won't risk losing it all just to talk.
Life isn't fair, Lizbeth. It's about time you realized that.
You've gone way too far. This ends now.
What's your problem?
Control?
Explain yourself.
I can't let you do this.
No, they won't
Will they?
Convince them otherwise.
Use your head.
You're naïve.
More valuable than lives?
They won't miss you, either.
It's a gimmick.
You see? You worry too much.
And you trust too easily, Juliana.
Don't worry about him. He only cares about "the company".
Relax, Jeong. They're obviously not geth.
Commander. What can I do for you?
As if we don't have enough problems. Now we're shooting each other in the back.
It's my fault. I knew what was going on and I didn't do anything.
Don't you start. You do good work and you know it.
I'm glad you've decided to help us. I think there's a way to avoid killing the colonists.
The insecticide we use in the gro-labs contains trace amounts of Tetraclopine, a neuromuscular degenerator.
Dodgy, but it might just work.
My men'll keep everyone safe here. If you're going, it should be soon.
A reduced-capacity concussion grenade might suit our needs.
If we must consider it, drop it in a concussion grenade.
We might be able to adapt a concussion grenade to deploy it.
Commander, I can make it work using our concussion grenades.
Please try to avoid hurting the colonists. Use the nerve agent I gave you, if you can.
Commander Shepard. I'm here to remove your geth problem.
I suggest you put that weapon down unless you're ready to use it.
Sounds good. I'll do what I can.
I'm not stopping to ask them to breathe deeply.
You did it. With the Thorian gone, we can start rebuilding for ourselves again.
